notes.title: Blessed mode (Update 2.1)
notes.notes:
Great update to make the game more accessible to all players: we premiered BLESSED MODE.
When you walk through the town you will see that an enigmatic chest has appeared. You will simply have to examine it to pick up a strange and powerful blessed coin. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30223789/218ed7e4b10209d1ade991cdb6fbaf38dda97e49.png

This will give you several advantages during the game:
- First of all your energy will recover automatically if you stop to rest.
- Every time you approach the well you can read your next goal in the sky. You will no longer be trapped or lost at any time. It even tells you the first steps if you start a new game.
- Certain enemies will be easier to defeat in this mode.
You can leave in this way simply by leaving the blessed coin in the same chest where you took it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30223789/0fcd58ab63fc02920e3ac4afc57ab580ac27e6bb.png

In addition, update 2.1 brings several improvements:
- Now the game has full compatibility with a game controller, you do not need to use the keyboard or mouse at any time if you wish.
-There is a new minigame in the old man's house in the mountain.
- Change in the graphics of the tavern's puzzles.
-Corrected the failure that was with the controls and small errors during the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30223789/b9fc291951a980ddd78a172351540b919f02985a.png
